meta.note: game.cfg: PrayerEfficiencyEarlyIncomeReductionV=10.1111, PrayerEfficiencyLaterGrowthG=0.01, PrayerEfficiencyModifierZ=10.0; proto.xml VillagerGreek Gather AbstractTemple rate 0.1. favor/s = N x (rate x Z / 10) x (1/(N + V) + G) = N x M x (1/(N + 10.1111) + 0.01), N = villagers praying across all Temples, M = 1 (Zeus and Golden Apples each +0.2 BasePercent on the rate, via favorRate modifiers). Table = favor/min for N = 1..30 at M = 1; matches the owner measurements (6.00 and 31.30). No praying limit in the files (Temple maxcontained 5 is for garrison); extrapolate with the formula above 30. No favor cap in the files.

MythicAgeHera/Artemis/Hephaestus: 1200 food + 1200 gold, 120 s, needs a Fortress. At Town Center or Village Center. MythicAgeGreek also creates a free Carcinos at a Dock (if any).
